11.9 Device Description
The Smart Coil functions to selectively embolize targeted segments of the vasculature by
packing a sufficient quantity of bare platinum coils to achieve occlusion in an identical
fashion to the Penumbra Coil System. The Smart Coil System consists of three
components: a Coil Implant attached to a Detachment Pusher and a Detachment Handle.
11.10 Indications for Use
The Penumbra Smart Coil System is indicated for the embolization of:
 Intracranial aneurysms
